summary: `/always-on` is now a real built-in TUI mode with explicit state and visible composer treatment.

findings.message: Added built-in `/always-on` and `/always-on-exit` slash commands in `packages/coding-agent/src/tui/tui-renderer.ts`.
Introduced explicit `composerMode` state in `packages/coding-agent/src/tui/tui-renderer.ts` instead of inferring always-on mode from extension-indicator labels.
`getComposerMetaLabel()` and `updateEditorBorderColor()` now reflect always-on mode visibly without changing normal chat behavior.
